questions.question: Which creature does the writer tell a lazy person to watch and learn wisdom from?
The writer warns a lazy person that after a little sleep and a little resting of the hands, what will come like a robber?
What did the writer say will happen to a wicked man who devises evil and sows discord?

answers.text: Calamity will shatter him in an instant
He will fade away in a slow decline
He will gain riches that never satisfy
